title: 第 10 课 · 电流表：串联才能测电流
summary: 电流表要串进电路里：先断开，再把表接进断口。并联会把元件短路——这一课里你会安全地看到这个错误。
description:
**这一课学什么**：用电流表（万用表的电流档）测电流。第 1 期以后的实验大量用到它。

**电压表和电流表正好相反**：
- 电压是两点之间的，万用表**并联**在两点上，自己几乎不取电流；
- 电流是流过一条路径的，电流表要**串联**：把电路在要测的地方断开，让电流从红表笔（+）流进表、从黑表笔（COM）流出来。
- 电流表的内阻（burden resistance）很小——这里是 0.1 Ω，几乎就是一根导线。所以把它并联在一个元件两端，等于用导线把元件短路。

**方向**：读数是“从红表笔流进去的电流”。红黑接反，读数变成负数——电流没变，变的是参考方向。

**电路**：9V 电池 → 黄色跳线（这就是之后要接电流表的地方）→ R1（1kΩ）→ 红色 LED → GND。

**先预测**：LED 正向压降约 1.8 V，算出流过 R1 的电流。

**仿真和真实电流表**：这里的电流表内阻固定 0.1 Ω。真实万用表的 mA 档内阻是几欧到十几欧（看说明书上的“负担电压”），在低电压电路里会让电流明显变小；10 A 档内阻小，但读不准小电流。真实的表并联在电源两端会**烧保险丝**——这里只会把元件短路、给出诊断提示。
compare:
**对比**：I = (9 V − 1.8 V) / (1 kΩ + LED 内阻 12 Ω) ≈ **7.1 mA**。
- 电流表两端的电压 = 0.1 Ω × 7.1 mA ≈ **0.71 mV**，所以它几乎不改变电路；
- 表笔接反时读数 ≈ −7.1 mA；
- 并联在 LED 两端时，LED 被短路熄灭，电流表读到的是 9 V / 1 kΩ ≈ 9 mA——这不是 LED 的电流，而是“被短路以后”的电流。

en.title: Lesson 10 · Ammeter: it goes in series
en.summary: An ammeter goes into the path: open the circuit, then bridge the gap with the meter. In parallel it shorts the part out — you will see that mistake safely here.
en.description:
**What you learn**: measuring current with an ammeter (the current range of a multimeter). The labs from phase 1 on use it all the time.

**A voltmeter and an ammeter are opposites**:
- voltage is between two points: the meter goes **in parallel** across them and draws almost no current;
- current flows along a path: the ammeter goes **in series** — open the circuit where you want to measure and let the current flow in at the red lead (+) and out at the black lead (COM).
- An ammeter has a tiny inside resistance (burden resistance) — 0.1 Ω here, practically a wire. Put it across a part and you short that part with a wire.

**Direction**: the reading is the current flowing in at the red lead. Swap red and black and the reading turns negative — the current is the same, the reference direction is not.

**Circuit**: 9V battery → yellow jumper (where the ammeter will go later) → R1 (1kΩ) → red LED → GND.

**Predict first**: the LED drops about 1.8 V; work out the current through R1.

**Simulated vs real ammeter**: this ammeter is always 0.1 Ω. A real multimeter's mA range has a few to over ten ohms inside (look for "burden voltage" in its manual), which noticeably lowers the current in a low-voltage circuit; the 10 A range has less, but cannot read small currents well. A real meter across a supply **blows its fuse** — here it only shorts the part and the diagnostics tell you.
steps: Pick "Jumper wire", click tp5 and a5 (you can make it yellow in Properties). The current enters the circuit from the + rail through this jumper — the ammeter will go here later.
R1: click c5 and c10, set 1kΩ.
Red LED: click d10 first (long lead, +), then d13 (short lead, −).
Jumper a13 → tn13 back to GND. The LED lights up.

**Do it wrong once**: pick "Ammeter", click b10 for the red lead and b13 for the black lead — the ammeter is **in parallel** with the LED. The LED goes dark: the 0.1 Ω meter shorts it. Click the ammeter and look at its reading in Properties: that is the current through the meter after the short, not the LED's current. The Diagnostics tab and "Check my circuit" both point it out: the ammeter is in parallel with LED1 — an ammeter goes in series. (A real meter across a supply blows its fuse.)
Delete that ammeter: pick "Select / use", click it, press Delete in Properties (or the Delete key).
**Open the circuit**: delete the jumper tp5 → a5. The LED goes out — the current has no path.
**Bridge the gap with the ammeter**: red lead on tp5 (where the current comes from), black lead on a5. The LED is back on and the meter shows the current of the whole loop.
Try the leads swapped: delete the ammeter and place it again, red lead a5, black lead tp5. The reading turns negative and the LED stays on.
Swap back: red lead tp5, black lead a5.
Press "Check my circuit", then answer the measurement questions (use the multimeter for the voltage across the ammeter).
hints: An ammeter goes in series: the current must pass through it. First find a place where the circuit can be opened.
Remove the jumper tp5 → a5 and put the two ammeter leads in its two holes, red on the side the current comes from (the + rail).
The voltage across the ammeter is tiny (below a millivolt); its resistance = that voltage ÷ the current.

measurements.ask: Ammeter AM1 reading (red lead on the + rail side)
Multimeter: red probe on the + rail (the ammeter's red side), black probe (Shift) on column 5: the voltage across the ammeter
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω × 7.1 mA ≈ 0.71 mV — ten thousand times smaller than the other voltages in the circuit.

measurements.ask: From your two readings, the ammeter's inside resistance: R = voltage across it / current
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω: practically a wire, which is why it must go in series.

measurements.ask: In step 10, when you swapped the ammeter's red and black leads, how did the reading change?
choices: it reads 0 and the LED goes out
measurements.explain: The current didn't change and the LED stayed on; the reading is the current flowing in at the red lead, so reversed it is negative.

tests.name: 电流表串在电路里，LED 亮

measurements.ask: 电流表 AM1 的读数（红表笔在 + 轨一侧）
万用表：红表笔点 tp 轨上电流表红表笔那一侧，黑表笔（Shift）点第 5 列：电流表两端的电压
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω × 7.1 mA ≈ 0.71 mV——比电路里其他电压小一万倍。

measurements.ask: 用你的两个读数算电流表的内阻：R = 电流表两端电压 / 电流
measurements.explain: 0.1 Ω：几乎是一根导线，所以它必须串联。

measurements.ask: 第 10 步把电流表的红黑表笔对调时，读数怎么变？
measurements.explain: 电流没变，LED 照样亮；读数是“从红表笔流进去的电流”，方向反了就是负数。

steps.text: 选“电池”（9V），单击 tp1（+）再单击 tn1（−）。
选“跳线”，单击 tp5 和 a5（属性里可以把颜色改成黄色）。电流从 + 轨经过这根跳线进入电路——之后电流表就接在这里。
R1：单击 c5 和 c10，阻值 1kΩ。
红色 LED：先单击 d10（长脚 +），再单击 d13（短脚 −）。
跳线 a13 → tn13 回到 GND。LED 亮了。
**先做一次错的**：选“电流表”，红表笔单击 b10，黑表笔单击 b13——电流表**并联**在 LED 两端。LED 灭了：0.1 Ω 的表把 LED 短路了。单击电流表看“属性”里的读数：那是短路以后流过电流表的电流，不是 LED 的电流。“诊断”标签和“检查我的电路”都会指出：电流表并联在 LED1 两端——电流表要串联。（真实的表并联在电源两端会烧保险丝。）
把这块电流表删掉：选“选择 / 操作”，单击它，在“属性”里点“删除”（或按 Delete）。
**断开电路**：删掉 tp5 → a5 那根跳线。LED 灭了——电流没有路可走。
**把电流表接进断口**：红表笔单击 tp5（电流从这边来），黑表笔单击 a5。LED 又亮了，电流表显示流过整个回路的电流。
对调表笔试试：删掉电流表，重新放，红表笔 a5、黑表笔 tp5。读数变成负的，LED 照样亮。
再换回来：红表笔 tp5、黑表笔 a5。
点“检查我的电路”，再完成下面的测量题（电流表两端的电压用万用表量）。

hints: 电流表是串联的：电流必须“穿过”它。先找到电路里可以断开的地方。
把 tp5 → a5 的跳线拔掉，电流表的两只表笔就插在跳线原来的两个孔里；红表笔在电流流进来的一侧（+ 轨）。
电流表两端的电压非常小（毫伏以下）；内阻 = 这个电压 ÷ 电流。
